verdict.headline: CORE, DBLP, and Semantic Scholar have not answered any run resmon has a record of.
detail: CrossRef, DOAJ, EuropePMC, HAL, OpenAlex, PLOS, PubMed, and Zenodo answered when last asked and are no longer in the most recent run's saved selection.
